description.value: Kamo Bakery is a family-run Middle Eastern bakery on Victoria Drive in East Vancouver with over thirty years of baking experience. It specialises in daily-baked Tandoori bread (NAN), Samoon sandwich bread, and traditional pastries such as baklava, kleicha, and labzina — items it claims to be the only bakery in Vancouver producing. All products are described as handmade, and the shop donates unsold goods to local non-profit organisations supporting low-income families.
